d: Actor Amitabh Bachchan has expressed strong displeasure with the media through a post on X . Reacting to a News18 Hindi report, he accused media outlets of misinterpreting his religious phrase, ‘Hathi Ghoda Palki, Jai Kanhaiya Lal Ki,’ and presenting it as a challenge to his opponents. He said the phrase is associated with Lord Krishna and should not be twisted for sensational headlines. Bachchan also referred to his 50 million followers and warned media outlets against distorting his words. He questioned the media's credibility, responsibility and respect while sharing his frustration…
